idea: Quick sort with the pivot chosen at random. No fixed input can force the bad O(n^2) case, because nobody knows which pivots will be picked. The expected time is O(n log n) for every input.
useWhen: You cannot trust the order of the input
You want quick sort without a bad case caused by the data
avoidWhen: You need exactly the same behaviour every run without a seed
You need a guaranteed worst case (use merge sort)
